location: harbor market row, near rope-seller's stall, by the harbor steps

events.summary: Sable orders Maren to Warden Row, second tide bell, ask for her
Sable states a second page exists with Maren's name; wants to discuss it in a room with a door
Constable notes the hour and the weather
Tovin tells Sable a woman in a green shawl offered Maren work and Maren said no; he does not know what the work was
Maren notices the woman in the green shawl was at the third stall the whole time and watched the encounter
Green shawl woman sets an object on the rope-seller's table and walks toward the harbor steps
Maren pays one silver mark to the rope-seller
Maren takes a sealed writ, council stock, red wax seal with a wren
Maren recognizes the wren seal from a door in the old quarter the night her sister did not come home
Maren orders Tovin to stay, count to two hundred, go to his cousin if they are not back
Maren leaves the stall; direction between harbor steps and Warden Row unresolved

choices: Break the seal. Read what the Council wrote before anyone else does.
Go after the woman in the green shawl, down the harbor steps.
Take the writ to Warden Row and ask Sable about the second page.
Go back to Tovin. Put him on his cousin's boat. Go alone.
Ask the rope-seller about the door with the wren on it.
